profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer supporting the development and deployment of OpenBMC on all of Meta's compute, storage, and machine learning platforms (most of which are released through OCP). Chair of the Linux Foundation OpenBMC project's "Technical Oversight Forum", providing technical direction and oversight for the project.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Cloud-Scale Machine Learning Acceleration - Annapurna AWS
positions.description: Software lead for Inferentia (ML inference chip) initialization and system management firmware.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Numerous years contributing and leading in firmware spaces for IBM: Host firmware ("BIOS"), service processor / BMC, and system management. 

Led IBM's open source firmware initiatives for OpenPower.  Started the OpenBMC project, now part of Linux Foundation.

Embedded Linux software development and design for the Service Processor in IBM Power servers.

positions.title: Internship - Software Engineering
positions.description: Embedded Linux software development and test.

positions.title: Computer Sales and Technician
positions.description: Personal Computer sales and support for residential and commercial customers.
